name: Gabriel Santos
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A Brazilian featherweight from Chute Boxe Diego Lima (10-0 before the UFC), 2-2 in the UFC: a split loss to Lerone Murphy, a R2 knockout by David Onama, then a decision over Zha Yi and a R3 submission of Jack Jenkins (UFC 312, February 2025). He has not fought since, nearly 22 months.

how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped by Onama (R2) and submitted once (early career).

keys_to_beat: Pressure him early after the layoff

news.text: Returns against Luke Riley at UFC Saudi Arabia.

sources.title: Late UFC Saudi Arabia Addition Could Steal "Fight of the Night" Honors
